name: Modge
summary: Desktop time tracking and workforce analytics for remote and hybrid teams: automatic hours, app and URL classification, shift adherence, leave, payroll-ready timesheets and Stripe invoicing. 14-day trial, no card.
best_for: desk-bound remote or hybrid teams of a few to a few hundred people who want time tracking, app classification, shift adherence, leave and payroll-ready timesheets in one seat priced between $4 and $7 a month, and who are happy to run screenshots as an opt-in rather than a default
skip_if: you need SSO or a SOC 2 report today, both are marked soon; your people work in the field, since the agent is desktop-only with no mobile or GPS on the page; or your security team will not accept a compliance claim without a document
honest_knock: The numbers on Modge's own pages do not agree with each other. The homepage says trusted by 1,000+ teams, the affiliate page says 1,800+ teams, the pricing page says over 2,000 users; the pricing page also shows three star ratings, 4.6 from 1,500 reviews, 4.8 from 2,000 and 4.2 from 800, without naming a single platform they come from. None of that touches the product, but it is the kind of copy a buyer should not repeat in a business case. What does touch the product is the comparison table: SSO through SAML 2.0, SOC 2 Type II and ISO 9001 are all marked soon, and HIPAA compliant appears with no report behind it. If your security review needs a document today, there is none to hand over. The desktop agent is macOS and Windows only, and the pricing page mentions no mobile app or GPS, so field teams are out of scope.

pricing.plans_source: hand-curated from the vendor's pricing page
pricing.notes: (read 2026-09-03 and re-verified 2026-10-16 on modge.com/pricing, both billing toggles and the comparison table; every amount unchanged) Per-seat plans with a full-feature 14-day trial. Our sign-up on 19 November 2026 asked for a card at step 5 of 5 before the app opened, with Due today $0.00. Basic is $5 per seat per month billed monthly or $4 billed annually: app and URL tracking with AI productivity classification, workforce dashboards, automatic time tracking with optional screenshots, timesheets, approvals and payroll exports, invoice creation, email and chat support. Pro is $7 monthly or $5.50 annually and adds shifts, scheduling and adherence, leave, breaks and overtime, client billing through Stripe, on-demand screenshots with 12-month retention, and custom roles, teams and project budgets. Premium, marked popular, is $9 monthly or $7 annually and adds automated project and task time tracking, workflow analysis, suspicious-activity and mouse-jiggler detection, burnout-risk and profitability insights, contract signing, 24-month screenshot retention and a dedicated account manager. Enterprise is custom, on annual billing with volume pricing, custom retention, customised onboarding and an SLA. Two add-ons are priced per seat: More Screenshots at $2 a month lifts capture from 18 to 60 an hour on Basic, Pro and Premium; Extended Data Retention at $2 a month or $1.67 annually keeps records for six years on every tier. The comparison table lists screenshot retention as 3 months on Basic, 12 on Pro and 24 on Premium, and marks SSO (SAML 2.0), SOC 2 Type II and ISO 9001 as soon. The FAQ's blanket 'Annual billing saves 22% over monthly' holds only for Premium ($9 to $7, 22.2%); Basic saves 20% ($5 to $4) and Pro 21.4% ($7 to $5.50), as the plan cards themselves say.

compare_with.name: Hubstaff
compare_with.why: The obvious comparison. Hubstaff's annual column starts at $4.99 a seat with a two-seat minimum and its monthly column at $7; Modge starts at $4 annual or $5 monthly with no minimum on the page. Hubstaff has the longer record, a mobile app with GPS and a far larger integration list; Modge's pitch is shift adherence, leave policies and Stripe invoicing built into a cheaper seat, with screenshots off by default. Pick Hubstaff for field teams, Modge for desk-bound teams that also need rotas.

exit_test.what: Daan created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in Daan's browser. On 19 November 2026 the session went through the sign-up of Modge in the account that Daan created and stopped at step 5 of 5: after the organisation (a phone number is required), the company size and the plan (Pro $7.00 per seat per month was preselected), an embedded Stripe screen asks for a card for the 14 day trial, with Due today $0.00 and US$ 7,00 per month from 3 December 2026. Our dossier says a 14 day trial with no card. Nothing was entered, so the trial did not start and the app could not be used: opening the app sent us back to Preparing your checkout. The product itself was not tested. Account and start: Daan created the account (the e-mail was confirmed and he was logged in) and our AI assistant worked in its own tab of Daan's browser; the second attempt started at 08:45 on 19 November 2026 at https://app.modge.com/setup-organization. The dossier name is Modge (modge.com) and the review is on OSM (osm/modge-review.html). The app was in English; only the Stripe payment screen was in Dutch. The second session leads; the first session (08:35) is only used where it adds a fact that the second does not repeat, and is named as such. First screen: Welcome to Modge! with the button Create Organization. It leads to Step 2/5, Let's Create Organization, with the fields Organization Name, Phone Number (with a separate country field) and Organization Timezone (Europe/Amsterdam (GMT+1)). We filled in a made-up organisation name, the country Netherlands (+31) and a mobile number, which Daan has given standing permission for; no box for marketing or for contact by sales was present. Next was accepted and no SMS code came. In the first attempt the same step was tried without a phone number and the app said Phone number is required, so the phone number is required to make the organisation. Step 3/5, How big is your company?: we chose 2-19. Step 4/5, Choose The Plan That Fits Your Team: Start a full-feature free trial. Cancel anytime. Monthly: Basic $5.00, Pro $7.00 (Popular) and Premium $9.00 per seat per month; Yearly is marked -29%. Pro stood preselected (1 seat, 1 seat x $7.00/mo) and the add-on More Screenshots at +$2.00 per seat per month was unticked. Choosing a plan is required in the sign-up; there is no button without a plan. Plans as the app shows them (step 4/5, monthly, per seat): Basic $5.00 with manual and automatic time tracking, screenshots (18 an hour), timesheets and approvals, projects, clients and payroll exports, Tracked Hours and App Usage reports and an API. Pro $7.00 (Popular) adds on-demand screenshots, Stripe client billing, shifts and scheduling with a Schedule Adherence report, leave, teams, a Manual Time Edits report and Priority support. Premium $9.00 adds the Unusual Activity report, Burnout-risk insights, the Profitability report and contract signing. The add-on More Screenshots is +$2.00 per seat per month (60 an hour). The public pricing page https://modge.com/pricing (first session, 19 November 2026): Start a full-feature 14-day free trial. Cancel anytime. Basic $4 per seat per month, billed annually, Pro $5.50 and Premium $7 (annual), Enterprise Custom, add-ons More Screenshots and Extended Data Retention at $2 per seat per month. No sentence about no credit card was found on that page. A seat is anyone whose time the desktop agent tracks; after the trial you convert to a paid plan or the account stays read-only for 30 days for export and is then removed; cancelling is from settings and runs to the end of the billing period (the cancelling route was read on the page, not seen in the app). Card step: Start Free Trial led to Step 5/5 with Selected plan Pro plan $7.00/seat/month and Due today $0.00, and an embedded Stripe screen in Dutch with 14 dagen gratis, then Vervolgens US$ 7,00 per maand vanaf 3 december 2026, a secure payment line with Link, an e-mail field and card information fields (card number, MM / JJ, CVC, name of the card holder). We stopped here and entered nothing. Opening https://app.modge.com/ in the same tab went back to Step 5/5 Preparing your checkout..., so without a card the app is not reachable and the organisation cannot be used. The trial counter was not seen in the app, because the app was not reached; Stripe says 14 days free from 19 November, so it runs to 3 December. Not tested: team members without an invitation mail, a project, 3 manual hours, the timesheet and a report, an export (CSV and PDF), the time to the first line of hours, the plans and the cancelling route inside the app. Screenshots: none are in the repo; the images of step 5/5 show Daan's e-mail address and a Dutch Stripe text and were not used. Clean up: the account exists; the organisation was filled in at step 2 but the sign-up was not finished, no trial started and no card was entered; the phone number was entered under standing permission and no SMS code was asked; the own tab was closed and Daan's own Modge tab was not touched. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The trial needs a card at step 5 of 5, before the app opens, although Due today is $0.00 and the plan page says Cancel anytime. A plan must be chosen in the sign-up, and a phone number is required for the organisation. The app sends you back to the checkout until a card is given, so you cannot look at the product first.
